SHOW_IN_MESSAGES_SUBTITLE: Adds the author's local time after a message's timestamp, when it differs from yours.
USE_DATABASE_SUBTITLE: Looks up the timezone people shared at timezone.creations.works. A timezone you set for someone always wins.
SET_TIMEZONE_BODY: An IANA timezone, such as Europe/Berlin or America/New_York.
INVALID_TIMEZONE: {zone} is not a timezone this device knows.
